name: R-4066
summary: R-4066 (Spirodone) is a drug which is a derivative of the opioid analgesic norpipanone, wherein the piperidine ring has been replaced by a tricyclic spiro heterocycle.07 mg/kg, but is shorter acting, with a duration of action of around 3 hours.5 hours compared to 8 hours for methadone.

pharmacology.text: R-4066 has not been researched in humans, but would be expected to produce effects similar to those of fentanyl, including strong analgesia, sedation, euphoria, constipation, itching and respiratory depression which could be harmful or fatal.

uses.en: It was made in research as a painkiller and has never been used as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究中作為止痛藥合成的，從未作為藥物使用。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究中作为止痛药合成的，从未作为药物使用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids of this kind cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and itching, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing, which can be fatal. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類鴉片類藥物會引起嗜睡、噁心、便秘和搔癢，過量時可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，可能致命。規律使用會導致依賴和戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类鸦片类药物会引起嗜睡、恶心、便秘和搔痒，过量时可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，可能致命。规律使用会导致依赖和戒断症状。

fact.en: R-4066 is norpipanone with its piperidine ring replaced by a spiro system, two rings joined at a single shared atom.
fact.zh: R-4066 是把 norpipanone 的哌啶環換成螺環系統，也就是兩個環共用一個原子相接。
fact.zhHans: R-4066 是把 norpipanone 的哌啶环换成螺环系统，也就是两个环共用一个原子相接。
